headline: How Much Does It Cost to Build an AI App in 2026?

itemListElement.name: How Much Does It Cost to Build an AI App in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an AI app in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused AI MVP typically runs £15k–£35k, a growth product £35k–£80k, and a scale platform £80k–£150k+. The spread comes from integration surface, data work and the accuracy bar — not the AI itself.

mainEntity.name: What are the ongoing costs of an AI app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Model usage (which scales with traffic), hosting and monitoring, plus maintenance — budget 15–20% of the build cost annually. Caching and retrieval keep model costs predictable.

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce AI app development cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scope to the single most valuable feature, ship behind a human review step, use API-based models instead of training your own, and build cross-platform so one codebase serves iOS and Android.
